meta.title: About Us — UnLitigate
meta.description: Why we started. UnLitigate is a student-led, non-commercial initiative backed by Students for Liberty, working to make mediation a first choice in India.

hero.heading: Why we started
hero.body: A student-led, non-commercial social impact initiative. Backed by Students for Liberty.

items.name: Anushka Jena
items.heading: The police station
items.body: The officer's question was quiet and practical: she would have to come to court every day. Was she sure? She was ready to file. Instead she went looking for a way to settle the dispute without giving up. That search is why UnLitigate exists. Choosing mediation is not a soft option. It is taking control of how a dispute ends — through a conversation, on your terms. Somewhere in India, someone is about to drop their case. Not because they were wrong. Because fighting costs years of peace. We built this so they have somewhere to look first.

image.alt: Quiet conversation at a desk, stand-in for Anushka's founding story

items.name: Madhur
items.heading: The wait
items.body: A dispute should not swallow a whole year of someone's life. Madhur saw how often people wait, then give up, not because the other side was right but because the process was heavier than the problem. Pune is where that observation became operations: a place to try supervised student mediation in a city that moves fast and still gets stuck. The work is practical. Train. Sit down. Write it down. Stay honest about what we can and cannot take. If the other side will not come, we say so. If they will, we make the room calm enough to talk.

image.alt: Campus walkway, stand-in for Madhur's story

items.name: Prakhar
items.heading: After it began
items.body: Prakhar joined after the project had a name, because the idea was already clear and still needed people who could carry it to universities, centres and anyone who would otherwise never hear the word mediation. Partnerships are how a student initiative becomes something a worried family can trust. The job is to be precise: what is live, what is a pilot, what is still being built. No slogans. Real moments. A first step that does not feel like a fight.

image.alt: City street at warm light, stand-in for Prakhar's story
